question: What is the meaning of (predictive) building circularity indicator in relation to performance indicators (an interpretation of the ce performance of a product)?
data_group: performance indicators (an interpretation of the ce performance of a product)
description: The (predictive) building circularity indicator in relation to performance indicators provides a measure of how effectively a building minimizes linear material flows and maximizes restorative flows for its component materials. It evaluates the extent to which a building utilizes virgin raw materials, generates unrecoverable waste, and considers the length and intensity of the building's use compared to industry-average products. This indicator assesses the level of circularity of a building based on the materials used, the building's lifespan, and the recyclability of materials at the end of the building's life cycle.
